title: An easy weekend
setting: Maya and Chris are on a quiet afternoon call, making a simple weekend plan. This is the slow, clear diagnostic: familiar topic, lighter reductions, more complete function words.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: So, what do you want to do this weekend?
lines.spoken: So, what do you want to do this weekend?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I don't know. I was thinking we could just get food and walk around. Nothing big.
lines.spoken: I don't know. I was thinking we could just get food and walk around. Nothing big.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: That sounds good. I have to do laundry Saturday morning, but I'm free after that.
lines.spoken: That sounds good. I have to do laundry Saturday morning, but I'm free after that.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. Maybe Saturday afternoon? We could go to that market, the one near your place.
lines.spoken: Okay. Maybe Saturday afternoon? We could go to that market, the one near your place.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, I like that market. We can go early, though, because it gets crowded.
lines.spoken: Yeah, I like that market. We can go early, though, because it gets crowded.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Two is not early, but two is fine.
lines.spoken: Two is not early, but two is fine.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay, two. And if it is raining, we can just go to a cafe instead.
lines.spoken: Okay, two. And if it is raining, we can just go to a cafe instead.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. I'll text you Saturday morning and we'll decide.
lines.spoken: Yeah. I'll text you Saturday morning and we'll decide.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Perfect. I need an easy weekend, honestly. This week was a lot.
lines.spoken: Perfect. I need an easy weekend, honestly. This week was a lot.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Same. Food and walking. That's the whole plan.
lines.spoken: Same. Food and walking. That's the whole plan.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's the whole plan. I love that.
lines.spoken: That's the whole plan. I love that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Do you want to look at the weather, or do we just wait?
lines.spoken: Do you want to look at the weather, or do we just wait?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: We can wait. I do not want to overthink it.
lines.spoken: We can wait. I do not want to overthink it.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Good. Then I'll see you Saturday, around two, near the market.
lines.spoken: Good. Then I'll see you Saturday, around two, near the market.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yes. Saturday, two, the market. I'm writing it down so I don't forget.
lines.spoken: Yes. Saturday, two, the market. I'm writing it down so I don't forget.

gist.askZh: 他们在计划什么时候见面、做什么？
gist.askEn: What are they planning, and when?

gist.askZh: 这是一个很复杂的计划吗？他们想要怎样的周末？
gist.askEn: Is this a complicated plan? What kind of weekend do they want?

details.askZh: Chris 周六早上要先做什么？他们约在几点？
details.askEn: What does Chris have to do Saturday morning, and what time do they say?

details.askZh: 如果下雨，他们怎么办？何时再确认？
details.askEn: What if it rains, and when will they confirm?

glue.span: what do you want to do this weekend
glue.hear: what do you want to do this weekend
glue.noteZh: 这段诊断里 want to 说得比较完整。后面更快的材料里，同样的位置常会变成 wanna。先听听完整形式。
glue.standard: what do you want to do this weekend

glue.noteZh: 这里的 because 也比较完整。注意 it gets 两个短词，说明市场会拥挤。

glue.span: I do not want to overthink it
glue.hear: I do not want to overthink it
glue.noteZh: do not want to 四个功能词都还在。更快的语速里，它可能变成 I don't wanna。
glue.standard: I do not want to overthink it

chunks.form: What do you want to do this weekend?
chunks.sayAfter: So, what do you want to do this weekend?

chunks.meaningZh: 没什么大事 / 简单就好。
chunks.sayAfter: We could just get food and walk around. Nothing big.
Food and walking. That is the whole plan.

roleplay.setupZh: 一个朋友问你这周末想干什么。你想要约一个轻松的计划：吃点东西、走走，不定太满。把时间、地点和下雨备选说清楚。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, calm and easy to talk to. He has laundry in the morning but is free after that. He will help you land a simple plan without rushing you.
variants: They pick a cafe from the start.
mustUse: What do you want to do this weekend
starters: So, what do you want to do this weekend?
I was thinking we could just get food and walk around.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话把这个周末计划讲出来：哪一天、几点、去哪、下雨怎么办。准备 15 秒，然后说 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Retell the weekend plan: which day, what time, where, and the rain backup. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
